answer: The nectar multiplier is published, charged in grove, and beacon lists each payment. A burst of registrations thus prices itself out, since the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 6 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 606 identities would post 933 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
